experiment: Two-phase teacher-controlled warm-start + on-policy OPD, t35 open the microwave
hypothesis: A student first trained on teacher-visited states, then on its own, reaches Teacher-10D task success more closely than the 500-update student-only run (0/40).
student: fresh Student-10D: pi05_libero base + gemma_300m_lora on the action expert, lora_b zero, lora_a seed 7, heads from the base; base, VLM and prefix frozen; not initialised from Student-100 or Student-500
unchanged_from_previous_500_update_run: AdamW lr 5e-5, b1 .9, b2 .95, eps 1e-8, wd 1e-10, clip 1.0
8 observations x 2 trajectories per update, one fresh episode per update
FP32 master on CPU, BF16 forward
random starts 900000+u with 0.04 rad arm noise, rollout noise 400000+1000u
stop rules: non-finite values, diagnostic KL above 1.5x initial

phase1.controller: Teacher-10D ODE actions (OpenPI sample_actions from the event noise); the student samples its own SDE chain on every observation and the loss is the same pathwise KL
phase1.episodes: successful teacher episodes only; a failed episode is re-rolled from start seed 920000+10u+try (noise 400000+1000u+100try), up to 10 tries, never trained on
phase1.observations: 8 per update by phase: 2 approach, 2 pre-contact (<= 0.12 m from the handle, no contact), 2 contact before the door moves, 2 early opening (door -0.05 to -0.8 rad); shortfalls filled in the order contact, opening, pre-contact, later opening, approach
phase1.pause: after update 100, full training state saved (master, optimizer state, diagnostic reference)

gate.set: development starts 960000-960039 (built like the training starts; distinct from training 900000-900499 and 920000+, from the diagnostic set 950000-950039 and from held-out demo_10..49)
measures: teacher-state executed-action and xyz error by phase (checkpoint 0 vs 100)
autonomous handle reach, contact, door movement and success of the update-100 student
takeover from the teacher's 25%, 50%, 75% states, with teacher resume as control
gate.pass_rule: update-100 student alone: door moved (<= -0.05 rad) in >= 10/40 AND handle reached (<= 0.12 m) in >= 20/40; OR >= 50% success from the 25% takeover point
gate.on_pass: pause for the user's review before Phase 2 (user's choice)

phase2.controller: current student, fresh rollout every update, observations evenly spaced as in the previous run
phase2.resume: same run directory, optimizer state restored

final_evaluation.states: held-out demo_10..49, env seed 7, noise 200000+100000*position+1000*state plus event, identical to the earlier benchmark
policies: curr_u000 (initial student; same function as base)
reported: paired bootstrap differences and McNemar p
similar rule: upper 95% limit of teacher - curr_u500 on ODE <= 0.15
final_evaluation.development_set_scoring: phase action errors and KL decomposition at all 9 checkpoints, takeover of curr_u500
